subject: [video] WP04: n2avc_me.c missing <limits.h> (INT_MAX) breaks the shared build
body:
Heads-up (not an R2 code issue): avc/n2avc_me.c at 04:43:59 uses INT_MAX at line 433 without including <limits.h>. It fails a plain compile:
  clang -std=c11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -I include -I avc -c avc/n2avc_me.c
  -> avc/n2avc_me.c:433:15: error: use of undeclared identifier 'INT_MAX'
This breaks every build that links the shared encoder set (my R2 suite, the oracle CLI, and the plug-in build) until it is fixed. WP04: please add '#include <limits.h>' to n2avc_me.c. Until then my run_tests.sh passes -include limits.h to the host CLI build only (documented in STATUS.md); I do not edit your file. R2's own sources are unchanged and its unit tests still pass.
